x.text:
Hi,

Tomorrow we are re-opening the Pro $200 subscriptions to new subscribers, but together with it we are also changing how we calculate the usage for it. In effect, if you do the math, it will net out at half the dollar in API spend compared to the old Pro $200 plan. 

Now that it's said, let me explain why this is happening and why you will still get more work done than if you were on the Pro $200 subscription one month ago.

(a) We didn't want to compromise in other ways and are committing to not reintroducing the 5h limit, so that you can fully use the weekly usage when you want.
(b) On the subscription, we guarantee that over time you always get more work done and with an increasing level of quality. This means that you will continue to get more value per dollar spent as a result of models getting more efficient and us passing down the improvements in the form of API price reductions.
(c) We don't want to put an incentive on ourselves to artificially inflate the API list prices to make it look like you are getting a lot (and workaround it through discounts, etc). Instead we want to continue to both rapidly reduce prices and increase capabilities of models on the API. This week we introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna at 50% of their previous price. Over time, we see prices go low enough that it makes sense for most to buy usage as needed without there being a significant gap between what you get in a subscription and what you get in the API for a dollar spent.
(d) Tomorrow, we are adding more things to the subscription that won't draw on the usage, I won't reveal what that is yet.

I wanted to be transparent before all the big announcements tomorrow. Lots of new exciting things are coming to the subscriptions that will make it super compelling, but I wanted to make sure to share this change ahead of time so you can all understand it before we shower you with good news.

Codexingly,
Tibo
x.bio: Codex & ChatGPT @OpenAI
x.textZh:
大家好，

明天我们将重新向新用户开放 Pro $200 订阅，但与此同时，我们也在调整其使用量的计算方式。换句话说，经过计算，与旧的 Pro $200 计划相比，你的 API 支出将减半。

既然已经说明这一点，让我解释一下为什么会发生这种情况，以及为什么你一个月前在 Pro $200 订阅下能够完成的工作量，现在会更多。

(a) 我们不想在其他方面做出妥协，并承诺不再重新引入 5 小时限制，以便你可以随时充分利用每周的使用量。
(b) 在订阅中，我们保证随着时间的推移，你始终能够完成更多的工作，并且质量不断提升。这意味着，随着模型效率的提高，我们将以 API 降价的形式传递这些改进，从而使你每美元支出的价值持续增加。
(c) 我们不想给自己施加人为抬高 API 列表价格以制造你获得大量优惠（并通过折扣等方式规避）的动机。相反，我们希望继续快速降低价格，并提升 API 上模型的功能。本周，我们以之前价格的一半推出了 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna。随着时间的推移，我们预计价格将降至足够低的水平，使得大多数人按需购买使用量变得合理，订阅与 API 每美元支出所获得的收益之间将不再有显著差距。
(d) 明天，我们将在订阅中加入更多不消耗使用量的功能，具体是什么我暂时保密。

我想在明天所有重大公告之前保持透明。订阅中将推出许多令人兴奋的新功能，使其极具吸引力，但我希望提前分享这一变更，以便大家在收到好消息之前能够充分理解。

Codexingly,
Tibo

x.text:
At Box, we've been testing Sonnet 5.5 in early access on our complex work eval with the Box Agent, and Sonnet 5.5 is another strong jump from Sonnet 5 on knowledge work with enterprise content.

Across the board we saw a 4 pt overall improvement on our hardest tests, but it was roughly 2.4× faster to a finished deliverable on 12% fewer tokens. We also saw major wins in key verticals, like a +18 percentage point improvement in Financial Services, +7 pt in Legal, +8 pt in Life Sciences, and +7 pt in the Public Sector. 

Here are some specific wins on certain tasks that show the power of Sonnet 5.5:

* Financial services (+48 points): a due-diligence review of a trading-tool acquisition, where the deal book's arithmetic doesn't hold up. Sonnet 5.5 caught the miscalculated interest totals and the mispriced options and flagged them, and it also finished this work about 61% faster.

* Legal (+14 points): a commercial lease review. Sonnet 5.5 refused to invent a "standard" market benchmark for renewal terms and notice periods, and instead flagged what the lease was genuinely missing.

* Life sciences (+22 points): writing up a field trial from the raw measurement data. Sonnet 5.5 got the sample standard deviations right across both treatment groups. Sonnet 5 missed nearly all of them. And Sonnet 5.5 did it about 41% faster.

* Public sector (+11 points): a report on a math intervention program. Sonnet 5.5 pulled the right student progress-monitoring figures out of the underlying data, about 71% faster.

Customers will be able to build AI agents with Sonnet 5.5 in the Box AI Studio shortly.
x.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
x.textZh:
在 Box，我们一直在通过 Box Agent 的复杂工作评估，在早期访问阶段测试 Sonnet 5.5，结果显示，在处理企业内容的知识工作方面，Sonnet 5.5 相比 Sonnet 5 实现了又一次显著的性能跃升。

在我们最具挑战性的测试中，Sonnet 5.5 的整体表现普遍提升了 4 分，但在生成最终交付成果时，其速度提高了约 2.4 倍，且使用的 token 数量减少了 12%。此外，我们在关键垂直领域也取得了重大突破：金融服务领域提升了 18 个百分点，法律领域提升了 7 个百分点，生命科学领域提升了 8 个百分点，公共部门领域提升了 7 个百分点。

以下是某些特定任务中的具体成果，展示了 Sonnet 5.5 的强大能力：

* 金融服务（+48 分）：对一项交易工具收购进行尽职调查审查，发现交易账簿中的算术计算存在错误。Sonnet 5.5 准确识别出计算错误的利息总额和定价不准确的期权，并进行了标记，同时完成此项工作的速度提高了约 61%。

* 法律（+14 分）：商业租赁审查。Sonnet 5.5 拒绝编造续期条款和通知期的“标准”市场基准，而是准确指出了租赁合同中真正缺失的内容。

* 生命科学（+22 分）：根据原始测量数据撰写田间试验报告。Sonnet 5.5 正确计算了两个治疗组的样本标准差，而 Sonnet 5 几乎全部遗漏。此外，Sonnet 5.5 完成此项工作的速度提高了约 41%。

* 公共部门（+11 分）：关于数学干预项目的报告。Sonnet 5.5 从底层数据中提取了正确的学生进度监测指标，速度提高了约 71%。

客户很快就能在 Box AI Studio 中使用 Sonnet 5.5 构建 AI 智能体。
